comparisonVerdict.rationale: Sample 01 communicates the active mission more completely: the arena, target list, objective, score, health, controls, and recharge state are all immediately legible. Sample 02 has a clear low-poly 3D arena and a visible attack projectile, but its presentation is sparser and gives less moment-to-moment mission context. Neither frame visibly demonstrates audio, so audio is scored as not applicable rather than inferred.

samples.biggestGap: The active frame does not visibly demonstrate particles or audio feedback.
samples.evidence: Strong tactical HUD hierarchy, readable arena grid, target roster, objective state, recharge meter, controls, player, enemies, pickups, and a clear attack aftermath make the loop easy to understand.
samples.label: sample-01

samples.biggestGap: The arena and HUD are readable, but the sparse composition does not show much particle or audio feedback.
samples.evidence: The angled 3D court, cover, three sentry targets, pickups, player, attack projectile, weapon meter, controls, and objective are all visible in one coherent frame.
samples.label: sample-02
